description: State Minister of Production, Supply and Regulation of Pharmaceuticals - Amended to the Medicine (Ceiling on Prices) Regulation, 2019
reasoning: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No. 5 of 2015. It specifically amends the Medicines (Ceiling on Prices) Regulations, 2019, setting maximum retail prices for various medicines and establishing regulatory compliance requirements for manufacturers, importers, and sellers. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing regulations.
